conventions.commits: Conventional Commits format with GPG signing and DCO sign-off
conventions.testing: Unit tests in #[cfg(test)] mod with semantic extractor integration tests
conventions.error_handling: Option types, no unwrap() in production code

patterns: LanguageInfo struct with optional query fields
extract_inheritance walks node fields for superclass/interfaces
DEFUSE_QUERY captures local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression, identifier

related_issues.title: Add Swift grammar support via tree-sitter-swift 0.7.3

constraints: Must follow existing language registration pattern (model after java.rs)
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for def-use analysis
test_coverage: Each language has unit tests for extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance, and defuse_query integration

library_findings.notes: Rust crate exports LANGUAGE constant; grammar.ts defines Swift syntax

approaches.name: Follow java.rs pattern exactly
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, extract_inheritance following java.rs structure
cons: Swift has different inheritance model (protocols vs interfaces)

approaches.name: Adapt kotlin.rs pattern
approaches.description: Kotlin has similar protocol/extension model to Swift

recommendation: Follow java.rs pattern exactly - it's the simplest, most tested approach. Swift's inheritance (class/protocol) maps cleanly to Java's (class/interface).
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

(function_declaration
  name: (simple_identifier) @function_name) @function
(class_declaration

(protocol_declaration

(struct_declaration
  name: (type_identifier) @struct_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (type_identifier) @enum_name) @class
(actor_declaration

inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-swift grammar.ts: class_declaration has 'inheritance_clause' child containing 'inheritance_specifier' with 'inherits_from' array of 'user_type' nodes, each having 'type_identifier' field for the base type name.
